classification.difficultyReason: Choose quarter-unit subdivisions and locate signed mixed numbers between adjacent integers, keeping negative fractional positions in the correct direction.

content.prompt: Draw a number line from $-5$ to $5$ and mark on it the positions of $-3\frac{1}{2},\,-4\frac{3}{4},\,-3\frac{1}{4},\,-1\frac{1}{2},\,1\frac{1}{2}$.

answer.short: From left to right: $-4\frac{3}{4},\,-3\frac{1}{2},\,-3\frac{1}{4},\,-1\frac{1}{2},\,1\frac{1}{2}$, marked on a number line from $-5$ to $5$.
answer.worked: Draw equally spaced integer ticks from $-5$ to $5$ and divide each unit into quarters. Mark $-4\frac{3}{4}$ one quarter to the right of $-5$; $-3\frac{1}{2}$ halfway between $-4$ and $-3$; $-3\frac{1}{4}$ one quarter to the left of $-3$; $-1\frac{1}{2}$ halfway between $-2$ and $-1$; and $1\frac{1}{2}$ halfway between $1$ and $2$.

spec.description: Complete answer number line with integer labels, quarter-unit subdivisions and five labelled positions. Ordinary marks and labels use black.
